title: Map changes affecting certain cemetery lands.
officialText: Notwithstanding any provisions of the not-for-profit corporation law, or of any other law, general or special, that portion of the city map relating to Interborough Parkway shall not be altered or amended so as to affect the lands of any cemetery association except by and with the consent of the trustees of any such cemetery association the lands of which would be affected, and of the board of estimate.
